boards.name: BIGTREETECH EBB36 CAN
notes: Confirm EBB36, V1.2 and the MCU marking on the physical board. EBB36 V1.0 uses a different MCU and CAN pins.
V1.2 moves the hotend heater output from the V1.1 pin PA2 to PB13. Use the V1.2 printer configuration.
These are hardware references, not an automatic build preset. The Klipper application offset must match the Katapult build installed on this board.

boards.name: BIGTREETECH Octopus
notes: Confirm the non-Pro Octopus V1.1 label and STM32F446 chip marking. Do not select this entry for an F429, F407 or H723 board.
The manufacturer documents a 32 KiB factory SD-card bootloader for this MCU. That factory offset is not a Katapult offset recommendation.
SD-card firmware updates require a working SD-card bootloader. Installing Katapult changes the bootloader arrangement; follow the initial setup guide for the selected method.

boards.name: BIGTREETECH Octopus Pro
notes: Confirm Octopus Pro V1.0 and the STM32F429 chip marking. The F446 and H723 variants need different processor and clock selections.
The manufacturer documents an 8 MHz crystal for F429, versus 12 MHz for F446. Board names alone do not identify these variants.
The documented 32 KiB factory SD-card bootloader offset does not establish the offset of a replacement Katapult build. SD-card updates require the factory bootloader to be present.

boards.name: BIGTREETECH Manta M8P
notes: Confirm M8P V2.0 and STM32H723 on the board. M8P V1.x boards use a different MCU; these settings do not apply to them.
The manufacturer configuration describes a 128 KiB factory bootloader. Set Klipper's offset to the actual Katapult application offset when replacing that bootloader.
The plug-in CB1 or CM4 is the Linux host; this entry describes the separate H723 printer-controller MCU. SD-card updates require the board's SD-card bootloader.

boards.name: BIGTREETECH EBB SB2209 CAN RP2040
notes: Confirm the RP2040 version on the board. The STM32 SB2209 and SB2240 versions are different products.
Initial USB system-boot mode is RP2040 BOOTSEL with UF2 support. Although the board guide calls it DFU, it is not STM32 DFU.
The manufacturer's Katapult example uses a 16 KiB application offset. Verify the actual selected Katapult offset before building Klipper; no offset is applied automatically.
